title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: Operational Visibility describes an unrecognized enablement value as a `sweep-did-not-run` record, while the decision matrix and AC18 define a distinct unrecognized-enablement record and reserve `sweep-did-not-run` for an unreadable, empty, or malformed category list. Define whether these are separate record types or one record with reason values, then align every surface.
